scope: 17 vanilla frame samples across 11 object families, plus one FU apiary frame; FU station/refuge and local machines inspected separately.

method.color_count: Distinct RGB values of alpha=255 pixels after RGBA source-layer composition; excludes transparent and partial-alpha pixels. Not a global palette rule.
method.coordinates: PNG coordinates from top left; bbox end exclusive.
method.composition: Crop named frame, alpha-composite optional lit/fullbright file above base in the recorded order, display on neutral background. No runtime lighting simulation or proof of engine ordering.
method.scale: Contact sheet nearest-neighbor 3x; relative native size preserved.
